title: airframe find --json
description: The hits of airframe find, best first.

name.description: the token's name, its DTCG path joined with -

tier.description: the token's tier; empty when it has none

type.description: the DTCG type; empty when the token has none

value.description: the base value in CSS spelling (an alias is var(--target)); empty when the token has no base value

why.description: with --file, why that file may read the token
